### 1. Getting Started with Positron

### 2. Getting Started with Posit Assistant

Posit Assistant, the AI agent in Positron: fixing a Quarto report, cleaning
data, building a Shiny app, and publishing it to Posit Connect.

### 3. Developing Chat-Based Data Applications You Can Trust

Adding a chat to a Shiny app with querychat, describing the data with
data-dict, and giving an agent trusted calculations with commons.

[Open the slides](03-developing-chat-apps.html){.btn .btn-primary}
